definitions.explanation: The persistent feeling of being inferior to others in terms of ability, appearance, status, or other attributes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{劣等感|れっとうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I have an inferiority complex about my educational background.

examples.japanese: {劣等感|れっとうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to overcome feelings of inferiority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べられて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{劣等感|れっとうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いた→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
examples.english: Being compared to my older brother gave me an inferiority complex.

PSYCHOLOGY:
Concept made famous by Alfred Adler's individual psychology. In Japanese psychological discourse, often discussed alongside ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧ (superiority complex).
